senses.gloss: m. (דור) inhabitant, lodger, tenant. Y. Maasr. II, 50ᵈ top, opp. to בעה״ב landlord; a. e.—Pl. דַּיּוֹרִים, דַּיּוֹרִין, דַּיָּירִין.
units: Ib. 10ᵃ מאי ד׳ … ד׳ ממש אטו ד׳ וכ׳ what is meant by dayyorin? Do you mean that no dwellers occupy the upper story?—Does the fitness of a residence depend on the existence of real dwellers?—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28:2">Gen. R. s. 28</cite>; a. fr.
